content: Today was a busy day, but I managed to get through it. My computer programming class went well, and I turned in my homework on time. Basketball practice was tough, and my elbow was bothering me the whole time. I need to make sure to take care of it so it doesn't get worse. I'm looking forward to unwinding with some video games before bed. Overall, I'm feeling good about balancing my classes and basketball, but I definitely need to prioritize taking care of my body.
